groups.title: 未 vs 末
groups.difference: Both are 木 (tree) with an extra line on top. In 未 the lower line is longer; in 末 the top line is longer.

hints.未: short top line: the tree has not yet grown - 'not yet'
hints.末: long top line: the tip at the very end of the tree - 'end'

groups.title: 大 vs 犬 vs 太
groups.difference: All three are 大 (big). 犬 adds a dot at the upper right; 太 adds a dot at the bottom between the legs.

hints.大: a person with arms spread wide - 'big'
hints.犬: dot up at the shoulder: a big animal at your side - 'dog'
hints.太: dot down between the legs: extra weight below - 'thick, plump'

groups.title: 人 vs 入 vs 八
groups.difference: 人 and 入 are two strokes that touch: in 人 the left stroke is the long one, in 入 the right stroke is the long one. In 八 the two strokes do not touch at all.

hints.人: long left stroke: a person standing - 'person'
hints.入: long right stroke: stepping in through an opening - 'enter'

groups.title: 右 vs 左 vs 石
groups.difference: 右 and 左 both start with ナ (a hand); 右 has 口 (mouth) under it, 左 has 工 (craft). In 石 the top line is a cliff-like 一 with the slanting stroke hanging below it, not crossing it, over 口.

hints.右: hand + mouth: the hand you eat with - 'right'
hints.左: hand + 工 craft tool: the hand holding the tool - 'left'
hints.石: a rock 口 under a cliff - 'stone'

groups.title: 待 vs 持 vs 特
groups.difference: All share 寺 (temple) on the right. 待 has 彳 (step/going) on the left, 持 has 扌 (hand), and 特 has 牛 (cow).

hints.待: 彳 step + 寺: stand at the temple - 'wait'
hints.持: 扌 hand + 寺: hold in the hand - 'hold, have'
hints.特: 牛 cow + 寺: the bull chosen for the temple - 'special'

groups.title: 険 vs 験
groups.difference: Both share the same right part (𠆢 roof over 口 and little legs). 険 has ⻖ (hill) on the left; 験 has 馬 (horse).

hints.険: ⻖ hill on the left: a steep slope - 'steep, danger'
hints.験: 馬 horse on the left: testing a horse - 'test, verify'

groups.title: 祭 vs 際 vs 察
groups.difference: All contain 祭 (festival: a hand offering meat over 示 the altar). 際 adds ⻖ (hill/wall) on the left; 察 adds 宀 (roof) on top.

hints.祭: hand and meat over 示 altar: an offering - 'festival'
hints.際: ⻖ wall beside the festival: the very edge - 'occasion, edge'
hints.察: 宀 roof over the ritual: looking closely inside - 'inspect, guess'

groups.title: 怒 vs 努
groups.difference: Both have 奴 (女 woman + 又 hand) on top. 怒 has 心 (heart) underneath; 努 has 力 (power).

hints.怒: 奴 over 心 heart: feelings boil over - 'angry'
hints.努: 奴 over 力 power: putting in strength - 'effort, strive'

groups.title: 午 vs 牛
groups.difference: Same strokes, but in 牛 the vertical line pokes up through the top stroke; in 午 it stops at the top.

hints.午: vertical stays inside: the sun at its peak - 'noon'
hints.牛: vertical sticks out like a horn - 'cow'

groups.title: 天 vs 夫 vs 失
groups.difference: 天 is 大 (big) with a short line on top and nothing sticking out. In 夫 the vertical pokes above the top line. 失 is like 夫 with an extra slanting stroke at the upper left.

hints.天: a line above 大: what is above a person - 'heaven, sky'
hints.夫: head poking above: a grown man with a hairpin - 'husband'
hints.失: a stroke slipping off the left: something falls away - 'lose'

groups.title: 見 vs 貝
groups.difference: Both are 目 (eye) on top. 見 has 儿 (legs) with a long hooked right leg; 貝 has two short splayed ハ strokes.

hints.見: 目 eye on 儿 legs: an eye walking around - 'see'
hints.貝: 目 with two short feet: a shell - 'shellfish'

groups.title: 目 vs 自 vs 白 vs 百
groups.difference: 目 is a box with two inside lines. 自 is 目 with a short slanting stroke on top. 白 has only one inside line plus the slanting stroke on top, and 百 is 白 with 一 (one) above it.

hints.目: box with two lines: an eye - 'eye'
hints.自: 目 with a mark on top: the nose, pointing to yourself - 'oneself'
hints.白: one inner line and a ray on top: bright light - 'white'
hints.百: 一 over 白: one hundred - 'hundred'

groups.title: 問 vs 間 vs 聞
groups.difference: All are 門 (gate) with something inside: 問 has 口 (mouth), 間 has 日 (sun), 聞 has 耳 (ear).

hints.問: 口 mouth at the gate: asking - 'question'
hints.間: 日 sun through the gate gap - 'interval, between'
hints.聞: 耳 ear at the gate: listening - 'hear'

groups.title: 開 vs 閉 vs 関
groups.difference: All are 門 (gate). 開 has 开 (two hands lifting a bar), 閉 has 才 (a bar wedged in place), 関 has 关 (并 horns over 天).

hints.閉: a bar blocks the gate: 'close, shut'
hints.関: a gate with a bolt: a checkpoint - 'barrier, related'

groups.title: 体 vs 休
groups.difference: Both have ⺅ (person) on the left. 体 has 本 (origin: 木 with a line near the bottom); 休 has a plain 木 (tree).

hints.体: person + 本 origin: the core of a person - 'body'
hints.休: person leaning on a 木 tree - 'rest'

groups.title: 輸 vs 輪 vs 論
groups.difference: 輪 and 論 share 侖 (𠆢 roof over 冊 neat bamboo slips); 輪 has 車 (vehicle), 論 has 言 (words). 輸 also has 車 but its right side is 兪 (𠆢 over 月 and 刂 knife).

hints.輸: 車 + 兪: carrying goods by cart - 'transport'
hints.輪: 車 + 侖 orderly spokes - 'wheel, ring'
hints.論: 言 words + 侖 in order - 'argument, theory'

groups.title: 栄 vs 営
groups.difference: Both have ⺌ and 冖 (cover) on top. 栄 has 木 (tree) underneath; 営 has two 口 (stacked boxes).

hints.栄: a tree in full bloom under the cover - 'flourish'
hints.営: rooms stacked under a roof: a camp, a business - 'manage'

groups.title: 復 vs 複 vs 腹
groups.difference: All share 复 (a person walking back: 𠂉, 日 and 夂). 復 has 彳 (step/going), 複 has 衤 (clothing), 腹 has 月 (flesh/body).

hints.復: 彳 going + 复: going back again - 'restore, return'
hints.複: 衤 clothing + 复: layers of clothes - 'duplicate, multiple'
hints.腹: 月 body + 复: the round body part - 'belly'

groups.title: 績 vs 積 vs 責
groups.difference: 責 (blame) is the base. 績 adds 糸 (thread) on the left; 積 adds 禾 (grain).

hints.績: 糸 thread + 責: spinning finished thread - 'achievement'
hints.積: 禾 grain + 責: stacking up grain - 'pile up, volume'
hints.責: a debt of 貝 money - 'blame, responsibility'

groups.title: 識 vs 職
groups.difference: Both share 戠 (音 sound + 戈 halberd) on the right. 識 has 言 (words) on the left; 職 has 耳 (ear).

hints.識: 言 words + 戠: knowing by words - 'know, discern'
hints.職: 耳 ear + 戠: listening to orders at work - 'job, post'

groups.title: 鳥 vs 島 vs 馬
groups.difference: 鳥 and 島 both have a bird head with a slanting stroke on top; 鳥 ends in 灬 (four dots), 島 replaces them with 山 (mountain). 馬 also ends in 灬 but has no slanting stroke or box on top - just mane lines.

hints.鳥: bird head with 灬 tail feathers - 'bird'
hints.島: a bird resting on 山 mountain - 'island'
hints.馬: mane lines and 灬 four legs - 'horse'

groups.title: 千 vs 干
groups.difference: In 千 the top stroke slants (ノ); in 干 the top stroke is a flat horizontal line.

hints.干: flat lines on a pole: a drying rack - 'dry'

groups.title: 万 vs 方
groups.difference: Both have a flat top line and a hooked stroke. 方 has a 亠 dot on top; 万 has no dot.

groups.title: 九 vs 丸
groups.difference: 丸 is 九 (nine) with an extra dot 丶.

hints.丸: a dot rolled into the curve - 'round, circle'

groups.title: 王 vs 玉 vs 主
groups.difference: All are 王 (king). 玉 adds a dot at the lower right; 主 adds a dot on top.

hints.王: three lines joined by a vertical - 'king'
hints.玉: a dot of jewel at the side - 'jewel, ball'
hints.主: a dot of flame on top: the lamp of the household - 'master, main'

groups.title: 木 vs 本
groups.difference: 本 is 木 (tree) with a short line across the trunk near the bottom.

hints.本: a mark at the base of the tree - 'root, origin, book'

groups.title: 母 vs 毎
groups.difference: 毎 is 母 (mother) with 𠂉 (a person) added on top.

hints.母: a woman's shape with two dots - 'mother'
hints.毎: a person over a mother: every generation - 'every'

groups.title: 名 vs 各
groups.difference: Both have 口 (mouth) at the bottom. 名 has 夕 (evening) on top; 各 has 夂 (walking slowly).

hints.名: 夕 evening + 口: calling out your name in the dark - 'name'
hints.各: 夂 feet arriving at each door 口 - 'each'

groups.title: 古 vs 占
groups.difference: Both have 口 (mouth) at the bottom. 古 has 十 (ten) on top; 占 has 卜 (divining rod).

hints.占: 卜 divining rod over 口: telling fortunes - 'fortune-telling, occupy'

groups.title: 反 vs 友
groups.difference: Both end in 又 (hand). 反 has 厂 (cliff) on top; 友 has ナ (another hand), so the strokes cross.

hints.反: a hand pushing against a 厂 cliff - 'anti, against'

groups.title: 因 vs 困
groups.difference: Both are 囗 (enclosure). 因 has 大 (big) inside; 困 has 木 (tree) inside.

hints.因: a person 大 resting on a mat - 'cause'
hints.困: a 木 tree boxed in, unable to grow - 'troubled'

groups.title: 東 vs 束
groups.difference: Both are 木 (tree) with a box across the trunk. In 東 the box is 日 (sun), with a line inside; in 束 it is a plain 口 with no inside line.

hints.東: 日 sun rising behind a 木 tree - 'east'

groups.title: 田 vs 由 vs 申
groups.difference: All are a box with a cross. In 田 the vertical stays inside; in 由 it pokes out the top; in 申 it pokes out both top and bottom.

hints.由: a sprout coming out the top: where it comes from - 'reason, cause'
hints.申: a line stretched through both ends - 'say (humble), monkey sign'

groups.title: 両 vs 雨
groups.difference: Both are 一 over 冂 (box). 雨 has four raindrop dots inside; 両 has a 山-like shape crossed by a centre line.

hints.両: four drops falling under the sky - 'rain'

groups.title: 内 vs 肉
groups.difference: Both are 冂 (box). 内 has one 人 (person) inside; 肉 has two 人.

hints.肉: two marks for the lines in meat - 'meat'

groups.title: 北 vs 比
groups.difference: 北 is two figures back to back, the left with 爿 (split wood) shape; 比 is two 匕 (spoon) shapes facing the same way.

hints.北: two people turning their backs to the cold - 'north'
hints.比: two people lined up side by side - 'compare'

groups.title: 字 vs 宇
groups.difference: Both have 宀 (roof). 字 has 子 (child) under it; 宇 has 于 (a vertical with a hook to the left, under two lines).

hints.字: a child learning under the roof - 'character, letter'
hints.宇: eaves stretching out under the roof - 'eaves, universe'

groups.title: 客 vs 容
groups.difference: Both have 宀 (roof). 客 has 各 (each) under it; 容 has 谷 (valley).

hints.客: 各 each person arriving under your roof - 'guest'
hints.容: a 谷 valley under a roof: room to hold things - 'contain, appearance'

groups.title: 遠 vs 園
groups.difference: Both contain 袁 (long robe). 遠 wraps it with 辶 (road); 園 encloses it in 囗 (enclosure).

hints.遠: 辶 road with a long robe: a long way - 'far'

groups.title: 適 vs 滴
groups.difference: Both have 啇 on the right. 適 has 辶 (road/movement); 滴 has 氵 (water).

hints.適: 辶 road + 啇: going just the right way - 'suitable'
hints.滴: 氵 water + 啇: a single drop - 'drip, drop'

groups.title: 違 vs 偉
groups.difference: Both have 韋 (leather/opposing feet) on the right. 違 has 辶 (road); 偉 has 亻 (person).

hints.違: 辶 road + 韋: walking a different way - 'differ'
hints.偉: 亻 person + 韋: an outstanding person - 'great'

groups.title: 側 vs 測 vs 則
groups.difference: 則 (rule: 貝 money + 刂 knife) is the base. 側 adds 亻 (person); 測 adds 氵 (water).

hints.測: 氵 water + 則: measuring water depth - 'measure'
hints.則: 貝 and 刂 knife: a fixed rule - 'rule, law'

groups.title: 陽 vs 場 vs 湯
groups.difference: All share 昜 (the sun rising over rays). 陽 has ⻖ (hill), 場 has 土 (earth), 湯 has 氵 (water).

hints.湯: 氵 water warmed by the sun - 'hot water'

groups.title: 銀 vs 根 vs 限
groups.difference: All share 艮 (stopping) on the right. 銀 has 金 (metal), 根 has 木 (tree), 限 has ⻖ (hill).

hints.根: 木 tree + 艮: where the tree stays put - 'root'
hints.限: ⻖ hill + 艮: a hill you cannot pass - 'limit'

groups.title: 増 vs 憎 vs 贈
groups.difference: All share 曽 on the right. 増 has 土 (earth), 憎 has 忄 (heart), 贈 has 貝 (shell/money).

hints.贈: 貝 money + 曽: giving valuables - 'give a gift'

groups.title: 税 vs 説 vs 鋭
groups.difference: All share 兑 on the right. 税 has 禾 (grain), 説 has 言 (words), 鋭 has 金 (metal).

hints.税: 禾 grain paid to the lord - 'tax'
hints.鋭: 金 metal + 兑: a honed blade - 'sharp'

groups.title: 具 vs 真 vs 直
groups.difference: All have 目 (eye) in the middle. 具 has a line and ハ under it; 真 adds 十 (ten) on top of that; 直 has 十 on top but an L-shaped stroke wrapping the bottom left instead of ハ.

hints.具: 目 on a stand with legs - 'tool'
hints.真: 十 + 目 on a stand - 'true'
hints.直: 十 + 目 with a straight L corner - 'straight, fix'

groups.title: 幸 vs 辛
groups.difference: 辛 starts with 立 (stand: a dot on top) over 十. 幸 starts with 土 (earth: a cross on top), then two dots and 干.

hints.辛: 立 on top: a needle - 'spicy, painful'

groups.title: 水 vs 氷 vs 永
groups.difference: 氷 is 水 (water) with an extra dot at the upper left; 永 has the dot on top, centred.

hints.永: a dot at the source of a long river - 'eternal'

groups.title: 者 vs 著 vs 署
groups.difference: 者 (person) is the base. 著 adds 艹 (grass) on top; 署 adds 罒 (net).

hints.著: 艹 + 者: one who stands out - 'author, remarkable'
hints.署: 罒 net + 者: an office that catches cases - 'government office, sign'

groups.title: 読 vs 続
groups.difference: Both share 売 (sell) on the right. 読 has 言 (words); 続 has 糸 (thread).

hints.読: 言 words + 売: reading words aloud - 'read'
hints.続: 糸 thread + 売: thread that keeps going - 'continue'

groups.title: 何 vs 河 vs 荷
groups.difference: 何 is 亻 (person) + 可. 河 swaps the person for 氵 (water). 荷 is 何 with 艹 (grass) on top.

hints.荷: 艹 + 何: a person carrying a bundle - 'luggage, load'

groups.title: 新 vs 親
groups.difference: Both start with 立 (stand) over 木 (tree). 新 has 斤 (axe) on the right; 親 has 見 (see).

hints.親: 見 watching from the tree: a parent - 'parent, intimate'

groups.title: 観 vs 権
groups.difference: Both have 隹 (short-tailed bird) under a 艹-like top. 観 has it on the left with 見 (see) on the right; 権 has 木 (tree) on the left.

hints.観: 見 see + the bird: watching closely - 'view'

groups.title: 忘 vs 忙
groups.difference: Both are 亡 (lost) + heart. In 忘 the 心 (heart) sits underneath; in 忙 the 忄 (heart) stands on the left.

hints.忘: 亡 over 心: the mind has lost it - 'forget'
hints.忙: 忄 beside 亡: no heart left - 'busy'

groups.title: 情 vs 清 vs 晴 vs 精
groups.difference: All share 青 (blue) on the right. 情 has 忄 (heart), 清 has 氵 (water), 晴 has 日 (sun), 精 has 米 (rice).

groups.title: 毛 vs 手
groups.difference: Same four strokes, but the long vertical of 毛 curves to the right at the bottom; in 手 it hooks to the left.

hints.毛: the stroke curls right like a hair - 'fur, hair'
hints.手: the stroke hooks left like a wrist - 'hand'

groups.title: 皿 vs 血
groups.difference: 血 is 皿 (dish) with a slanting stroke on top.

groups.title: 波 vs 破 vs 被
groups.difference: All share 皮 (skin) on the right. 波 has 氵 (water), 破 has 石 (stone), 被 has 衤 (clothing).

groups.title: 炭 vs 岸
groups.difference: Both have 山 (mountain) over 厂 (cliff). 炭 has 火 (fire) at the bottom; 岸 has 干 (dry).

hints.岸: 干 dry land under the cliff - 'shore, bank'

groups.title: 格 vs 絡 vs 略 vs 路
groups.difference: All share 各 (each) on the right. 格 has 木 (tree), 絡 has 糸 (thread), 略 has 田 (field), 路 has ⻊ (foot).

hints.絡: 糸 thread + 各: threads twining - 'entwine, connect'
hints.略: 田 field + 各: shortened plots - 'abbreviate'

groups.title: 砂 vs 秒
groups.difference: Both share 少 (few, little) on the right. 砂 has 石 (stone); 秒 has 禾 (grain).

hints.秒: 禾 grain tip: a tiny unit - 'second'

groups.title: 使 vs 便 vs 硬
groups.difference: 使 has 吏 (an official) on the right; 便 and 硬 have 更 (anew), which has a 日-like box with an extra inner line. 使 and 便 have 亻 (person); 硬 has 石 (stone).

hints.使: 亻 + 吏 official: send on an errand - 'use'

groups.title: 符 vs 府 vs 付
groups.difference: 付 (attach: 亻 person + 寸 hand) is the base. 符 adds 竹 (bamboo) on top; 府 adds 广 (building).

hints.府: 广 building + 付: where records go - 'government office, prefecture'
hints.付: 亻 + 寸 hand: handing over - 'attach'

groups.title: 脳 vs 悩
groups.difference: Both share the same right part (ツ-like top over 凶). 脳 has 月 (flesh/body); 悩 has 忄 (heart).

groups.title: 坂 vs 板 vs 版 vs 販
groups.difference: All share 反 (against) on the right. 坂 has 土 (earth), 板 has 木 (wood), 版 has 片 (a piece of wood), 販 has 貝 (money).

groups.title: 貿 vs 留
groups.difference: Both share the same top (a 刀-like part with 厶). 貿 has 貝 (money) underneath; 留 has 田 (field).

hints.留: 田 field: staying in place - 'stay, detain'

groups.title: 堂 vs 常 vs 賞 vs 党
groups.difference: All have ⺌ over 冖 (cover). Under it, 堂 has 口 + 土 (earth), 常 has 口 + 巾 (cloth), 賞 has 口 + 貝 (money), and 党 has 口 + 儿 (legs).

groups.title: 超 vs 起
groups.difference: Both have 走 (run) wrapping the left and bottom. 超 has 召 (summon) inside; 起 has 己 (self).

hints.超: 走 run + 召: running beyond - 'exceed, super'
hints.起: 走 + 己 self: getting yourself up - 'wake up, rise'

groups.title: 通 vs 痛 vs 踊
groups.difference: All share 甬 on the right. 通 has 辶 (road), 痛 has 疒 (sickness), 踊 has ⻊ (foot).

groups.title: 辺 vs 込
groups.difference: Both have 辶 (road). 辺 has 刀 (sword) inside; 込 has 入 (enter).

hints.辺: 刀 + 辶: the edge cut off - 'area, edge'
hints.込: 入 enter + 辶: going inside - 'crowded, include'

groups.title: 述 vs 術 vs 迷
groups.difference: 述 and 術 share 朮 (木 with one dot); 述 has 辶 (road), 術 has 行 (go) around it. 迷 has 辶 with 米 (rice), which has two dots on top.

hints.術: 行 + 朮: the way of doing - 'technique, art'
hints.迷: 辶 + 米: roads branching every way - 'lost'

groups.title: 校 vs 郊 vs 効
groups.difference: All share 交 (mix) on the left. 校 has 木 (tree) before it, 郊 has 阝 (village) after it, 効 has 力 (power) after it.

groups.title: 訪 vs 放 vs 防
groups.difference: All share 方 (direction). 訪 has 言 (words) on the left, 放 has 攵 (strike) on the right, 防 has ⻖ (hill) on the left.

hints.訪: 言 words + 方: calling on someone - 'visit'
hints.放: 方 + 攵: let it go - 'release'

groups.title: 雪 vs 雲 vs 電
groups.difference: All have 雨 (rain) on top. 雪 has ヨ (a hand/broom) underneath, 雲 has 云 (say/cloud), 電 has a 申-like lightning bolt.

groups.title: 住 vs 注 vs 柱 vs 駐
groups.difference: All share 主 (master) on the right. 住 has 亻 (person), 注 has 氵 (water), 柱 has 木 (wood), 駐 has 馬 (horse).

groups.title: 技 vs 枝 vs 抜
groups.difference: 技 and 枝 share 支 (branch/support); 技 has 扌 (hand), 枝 has 木 (tree). 抜 also has 扌 but its right is 犮, with a dot.

hints.抜: 扌 hand + 犮: pulling out - 'pull out'

groups.title: 投 vs 役 vs 設
groups.difference: All share 殳 (weapon/strike) on the right. 投 has 扌 (hand), 役 has 彳 (step), 設 has 言 (words).

groups.title: 旅 vs 族
groups.difference: Both have 方 on the left and a flag (𠂉) on the top right. Under the flag, 旅 has two small people; 族 has 矢 (arrow).

hints.族: 矢 arrow under a flag - 'tribe, family'

groups.title: 祖 vs 組 vs 助
groups.difference: All contain 且. 祖 has 礻 (altar) on the left, 組 has 糸 (thread) on the left, 助 has 力 (power) on the right.

groups.title: 礼 vs 札
groups.difference: Both have 乚 (a hook) on the right. 礼 has 礻 (altar); 札 has 木 (wood).

groups.title: 科 vs 料
groups.difference: Both have 斗 (measuring dipper) on the right. 科 has 禾 (grain stalk); 料 has 米 (rice).

hints.科: 禾 + 斗: sorting grain - 'department, course'
hints.料: 米 rice + 斗: measuring materials - 'fee, ingredients'

groups.title: 季 vs 委
groups.difference: Both have 禾 (grain) on top. 季 has 子 (child) underneath; 委 has 女 (woman).

hints.委: 禾 + 女: leaving it to someone - 'entrust, committee'

groups.title: 市 vs 布
groups.difference: Both end in 巾 (cloth). 市 has 亠 (lid with a dot) on top; 布 has ナ (a hand) crossing it.

hints.市: 亠 + 巾: banner over a stall - 'market, city'

groups.title: 今 vs 令 vs 冷
groups.difference: 今 and 令 both have 𠆢 (roof) and a line; 今 ends in a フ-like stroke, 令 ends in 卩 (kneeling person). 冷 is 令 with 冫 (ice) on the left.

groups.title: 退 vs 追
groups.difference: Both have 辶 (road). 退 has 艮 (stopping); 追 has 𠂤 (a column of two boxes).

groups.title: 貸 vs 貨 vs 資
groups.difference: All have 貝 (money) at the bottom. 貸 has 代 (substitute) on top, 貨 has 化 (change), 資 has 次 (next).

groups.title: 紙 vs 低 vs 底
groups.difference: 紙 has 氏 (clan) on the right with 糸 (thread). 低 and 底 have 氐, which is 氏 with an extra dot at the bottom; 低 has 亻 (person), 底 has 广 (building).

hints.紙: 糸 thread + 氏: fibre sheets - 'paper'

groups.title: 緑 vs 録
groups.difference: Both share 彔 on the right. 緑 has 糸 (thread); 録 has 金 (metal).
